change: Separate transferable observed power-transition memory from base-specific correction utility. Condition analogs on observed pitch and actual relative-yaw cosine, never hidden backbone states.
history: Last12 observed wind/power coordinates; optionally mean/last/change of mean blade pitch, mean/last cosine of Wdir (already relative to nacelle). All key scaling uses expert-fit source turbines only. Base-change key excluded in all four arms.
readout: transition: anchor_query + turbine-balanced median(Y_source-anchor_source), contrasted against current base and bounded to 20% capacity; residual ablation: base_query + median(Y_source-base_source).
identity: Transition memory identity excludes base checkpoint/manifest because neither keys nor stored targets depend on them. Residual memory retains them. Every utility policy binds the exact memory, current base, feature/rule/data convention and evaluated calibration outputs. Changing base invalidates utility but need not refit transition memory.

splits.held_out_scope: knowledge only; frozen base may have seen these turbines

transport.decision: Same v13 rule: both temporal blocks have positive turbine-balanced MAE and MSE gain; finest supported joint/power/event cell, harmful fine cell vetoes pooled backoff.

decision: Report all four arms without selecting a winner or changing rules on the check interval. Primary hypothesis is declared transition_control jointly improves MAE/RMSE and accepted-cell support versus residual_no_control. Zero intervention is not profitable transport. No automatic outer refit or additional seeds.
